text: Al Salam Bank is a public bank listed on Bahrain Bourse since 2006; its disclosed major shareholders are Bank Muscat SAOG (14.74%), Muscat Overseas Group (8.43%) and Sayacorp B.S.C Closed (6.28%).
short: Al Salam Bank is a listed Bahraini bank; largest holder Bank Muscat at 14.74%
